### Summary

I found no correctness or security problems. The tray menu template, the recording-state rebuild, the hash navigation, the i18n keys, the tests and the docs all look consistent. The Electron boundary is not widened, and `ROUTES` is a plain constants file. The menu is also rebuilt on every settings change, so the displayed accelerators stay current. My only finding is a note on an empty-object cast in `tray.ts`.
